_comment: A snapshot from a hypothetical future device that reports a key this build has never heard of (tank1.densityKgPerL) and a device-level key it does not know (uptimeSec). Per the compatibility policy, a V1 reader must parse everything it does recognise and silently ignore the rest — it must NOT error. Both the Go and the Android parser are expected to accept this fixture and produce exactly the one tank below.
